title: Crystalized Lemon Lime 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Crystalized’s Lemon Lime is a bright and zesty citrus blend that delivers a refreshing fusion of sharp Lemon and tangy Lime. The Lemon brings a crisp, citrusy bite, while the Lime adds an extra layer of tart, mouth-watering zest. Together, they create a lively and uplifting vape with a clean, citrus finish that lingers on the tastebuds. With a versatile 50% VG / 50% PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crystalized is a UK-based e-liquid brand dedicated to crafting distinctive, flavourful vape juices with an emphasis on MTL vaping. Their 50/50 VG/PG shortfills deliver clean, bright, and consistent flavours, making them an excellent choice for everyday vaping.
